title: Operators [Comparison & Logic]
description:
## Comparison Operators
- `==` equal
- `!=` not equal
- `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`

## Logic Operators
- `&&` AND
- `||` OR
- `!` NOT

```rust
let x: i32 = 10;
println!("{}", x > 5 && x < 20);  // true
println!("{}", x == 10 || x == 20);  // true
println!("{}", !(x > 100));  // true
```
